description: Na₆PbO₅ crystallizes in the tetragonal I4mm space group. There are two inequivalent Na¹⁺ sites. In the first Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to five O²⁻ atoms to form distorted NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with four equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one PbO₅ trigonal bipyramid, corners with seven equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids, edges with two equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent PbO₅ trigonal bipyramids, and edges with four equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.50 Å. In the second Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to four equivalent O²⁻ atoms to form NaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent PbO₅ trigonal bipyramids, corners with eight equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids, edges with two equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with four equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are two shorter (2.19 Å) and two longer (2.26 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Pb⁴⁺ is bonded to five O²⁻ atoms to form distorted PbO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with eight equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra, corners with four equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids, and edges with eight equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There is one shorter (2.12 Å) and four longer (2.18 Å) Pb-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent O²⁻ sites. In the first O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded to six Na¹⁺ and one Pb⁴⁺ atom to form a mixture of distorted corner, edge, and face-sharing ONa₆Pb pentagonal bipyramids. In the second O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four equivalent Na¹⁺ and one Pb⁴⁺ atom.
